item.tib: rtsa gsum rab 'byams 'dus pa'i rgyud las byad kha gtad khram bzlog byed me yi 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces stong rgyung drag po'i rgyud las bzlog (zlog) pa me dpung 'khor lo 'di nyid/ gsang ba sngags kyi bdag nyid gar dbang bdud 'dul snying po'am/ stong rgyung rol gar g.yung drung bstan 'dzin grags pa dang / snying gi tha tshig la gnas pa'i dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs gnyis nas dar dkar dri med yug ring gis sna drangs nas/ yang yang bskur (bskul) ba dang / phyis su rang gam du gnas pa'i yang slob btsun chung g.yung phun nas dar dri med kyis 'tshams (mtshams) sbyar ba nas bskur (bskul) ba dang / nye 'brel sngags 'chang dpal sdis nas gus pas gsol ba drag tu btab nas bskul ba la brten nas/ tshe dbang mngon byang (byon) tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ snyigs dus skabs su bab pa'i rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal lung bzhin du/ shar grol smin gling du/ bkra shis pa'i dga' ston nyin par spel zhing brgyud pa'o/ dge des bar chad byad ma ming med du brlag pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
